image_urls.description: ESP32-CAM live feed simulation of Mumbai underground drainage chamber showing water flow and debris
Industrial IoT ultrasonic water level sensor in manhole

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid. Use Tailwind CSS with the specified dark navy palette (#0B0F17, #00E5FF accent, #10B981 green, #F59E0B amber, #EF4444 red). Implement Leaflet map for Mumbai drainage GIS nodes, ESP32-CAM video stream modal/view, analytics 30-day health chart, alert management, and login screen with municipal badge.
universal_guidelines: Always include data-testid on interactive elements
Use dark navy and electric cyan engineering theme
Never use fully transparent backgrounds without blur
Ensure high contrast text for accessibility
